map.概率计算（本页代码口径，六模式）：正态 between P(a≤X≤b)=Φ((: Probability calculation (per this page's code, six modes): normal between P(a≤X≤b)=Φ((b−μ)÷σ)−Φ((a−μ)÷σ) (Φ implemented via erf, also supporting pdf/cdf/inverse cdf); binomial pmf=C(n,k)·p^k·(1−p)^(n−k), between=CDF(b)−(CDF(a−1) if a>0 else 0); Poisson pmf=λ^k·e^(−λ)÷k!; uniform and exponential use the standard pdf/cdf/inverse cdf; for basic probability, independent events give P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B), P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A)P(B), while mutually exclusive events give an intersection of 0 and a union of min(1, pa+pb). Validation: normal σ>0, inverse cdf probability∈(0,1), binomial n≥1 and p∈[0,1], Poisson λ≥0, uniform upper bound>lower bound, exponential λ>0, basic probability∈[0,1]; otherwise each prompts and stops. Grading: no fixed tiers; each distribution comes with an E(X)/Var(X) card — normal μ,σ², binomial np,np(1−p), Poisson λ,λ, uniform (a+b)÷2,(b−a)²÷12, exponential 1÷λ,1÷λ².
